description: Installs the MCP tools the POC onboarding skill drives: appliance status with next steps, admin UI links, log and failure diagnosis, resource handler verification and location import, environment creation, order-form trimming, OS build import, Custom Server setup, the playbook text, the install step and POC item tracking, plus the repository sync, job log and blueprint permission tools they reuse.
